platform.kernel: supported distribution-signed stable or longterm kernel
platform.base: one selected supported RPM distribution release; do not mix vendors
platform.lsm_profile: SELinux enforcing; unknown does not pass

components.name: service_catalogue
components.state: validated planner and unit renderer; site activation adapter required

components.name: network_transaction
components.state: durable controller and actual checkpoint calls; site policy and authenticated observation required

components.name: boot_assessment
components.state: assessment predicate; boot image writer, systemd-boot/grub integration and attestation not supplied

components.name: system_composition
components.state: authenticated composition checker; not whole-native-RPMDB executor

components.name: qualification
components.state: signature verifier bound to exact subjects; no real qualifying attestations supplied

components.name: bootloader_and_recovery_image
components.implementation: reuse signed distro shim/GRUB or qualified systemd-boot chain

components.name: accounts_and_credentials
components.implementation: reuse NSS/PAM and site secret provider
components.state: provisioning, rotation and policy adapter required; no fixture trust

components.name: audit_and_diagnostics
components.implementation: reuse auditd/journald/rasdaemon/kdump with restricted external retention
components.state: site retention, redaction and crash-dump access policy required

components.name: cluster_and_fencing
components.state: hardware and data-path integration and partition testing required

components.name: backup_and_data
components.implementation: existing admission/retention policy + application-specific backup engine
components.state: restore execution and measured recovery tests required

components.name: installer_and_repository
components.implementation: existing distribution installer and signed binary repository
components.state: custom ISO, native root/RPMDB migration, release service not completed
